dimensions.assessment: Affects NOAA personnel, emergency management agencies, and the general public relying on weather alerts, particularly in remote or underserved areas.
dimensions.evidence: areas without broadband internet access service... or State or local emergency warning systems

dimensions.assessment: Modifies agency operations, provides direct hire authorities, reclassifies specific federal occupations, and updates weather dissemination networks.
dimensions.evidence: categorize each position in the National Oceanographic and Atmospheric Administration specified... as a protective service occupation

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes $20 million annually for fiscal years 2026 through 2031, plus an additional $100 million for fiscal year 2026.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2031, $20,000,000 to operate NOAA Weather Radio... and for fiscal year 2026, $100,000,000

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Weather Research and Forecasting Innovation Act of 2017 to add new titles, standards, staffing requirements, and modernization initiatives.
dimensions.evidence: The Weather Research and Forecasting Innovation Act of 2017 (15 U.S.C. 8501 et seq.) is amended by adding at the end the following new title

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent operational changes, multi-year funding authorizations, and multi-year reporting and assessment mandates.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2031, $20,000,000

importance_detail.rationale: The bill provides millions in funding and mandates modernization, staffing plans, and expanded coverage for NOAA weather radios and public safety positions, creating moderate operational and fiscal impacts.
